summary: Dislike a track on behalf of a user
description: Marks a specific track as disliked for the authenticated Jamendo user. Requires a valid client_id and an OAuth2 access token with the 'music' scope. The response contains metadata in the headers and an empty results array.

requestBody.name: client_id
requestBody.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com

requestBody.name: fullcount
requestBody.description: If true, includes the total possible result count in the response header (may impact performance)

requestBody.name: access_token
requestBody.description: A valid OAuth2 access token with the 'music' scope for the user to update

requestBody.name: track_id
requestBody.description: Identifier of the track to dislike

responseFields.name: headers
responseFields.description: Metadata about the request response, including status and result counts

responseFields.name: results
responseFields.description: List of results (empty for the dislike operation)

notes: Both client_id and access_token are required; the token must have the 'music' scope.
The 'fullcount' parameter can affect performance and is optional.
The response always returns an empty results array for a successful dislike action.
